summary: Nuvve Holding Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a Securities Purchase Agreement dated September 10, 2026 with FirstFire Global Opportunities Fund, LLC for a $280,000 convertible promissory note issued at a $30,000 OID for a $250,000 purchase price. The note carries 12% interest, matures September 10, 2027, and converts after six months at the lesser of $1.40 or 85% of the ten-day lowest trading price, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap, with piggyback registration rights. The filing also references an Exchange Agreement with holders of 2,238.655 Series A Preferred shares, suggesting a broader recapitalization of the capital structure.
